normalize_gtest_json_output: normalize a Google Test JSON output object by replacing timestamps, times, and stack traces with wildcards
normalize_time_fields: normalize time fields in a Google Test JSON object by replacing duration values with asterisks
normalize_timestamp_fields: normalize timestamp fields in a Google Test JSON object by replacing ISO timestamps with asterisks
normalize_failure_messages: normalize failure messages in Google Test JSON by masking file line numbers and stack traces
normalize_nested_json: recursively normalize nested dicts and lists in Google Test JSON output to remove transient data
